Soundtrack Tel Aviv Festival 2026 | November 24–28 | Tel Aviv Cinematheque

The festival highlights narrative and documentary films in which music or sound serve as more than mere aesthetic accompaniment—acting instead as a vital component of the film’s artistic identity, whether as a narrative driving force, a space for documentary exploration, or an emotional and experiential anchor.
